topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I opened the small, unassuming package today, a note attached—handwriting I recognized instantly. It was from one of my former students, now years gone. A gift, something personal, a beautiful old book I’d once mentioned in passing, lovingly wrapped. The page markers inside were from lessons we’d shared, moments we’d spent together in that classroom. I shouldn’t have kept it so long before opening, wondering what could be so important. Now, holding it, I think about all the other times I could have reached out, shown I cared more. But here we are, and the book is a wonderful reminder of why I do what I do. Still, I can’t help but wish I had done more for them. Maybe I still can.
